title: Learning Who Disagrees: Demographic Importance Weighting for Modeling Annotator Distributions with DiADEM
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks models on their ability to predict human judgments regarding 'conversational safety' (DICES dataset) and 'political offense' (VOICED dataset). These categories are fundamentally ethical and moral, and the paper explicitly notes that 'moral values and political ideology mediate cross-cultural differences in offensiveness perception.'
